description.blurb: Gridr (formerly S/2004 S 20 and Saturn LIV) is a natural satellite of Saturn discovered in 2004 and announced in 2019.
description.more: In mythology, Gridr is a Norse giantess, and a consort of Odin who warned Thor of Geirrod's treachery and equipped Thor with her belt, iron glove, and staff. Gridr is about 4 kilometres in diameter, and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 19.418 Gm in 1010.55 days, at an inclination of 163° to the ecliptic, in a retrograde direction and with an eccentricity of 0.197.​
